caveat: max TOI is postgame and is not authoritative starter identity; fitted start_flag is null, so training-sample starter purity cannot be certified.
fitted_target: y_saves from actual goalie-game participation row
retained_prediction_semantics: conditional Saves distribution given that the named goalie starts
semantic_basis: start_prob was fixed at 1.0 throughout fit and is not a learned participation mixture; live output is not multiplied by a start probability. Lower-TOI participation rows are retained model-target contamination/uncertainty, not an unconditional start-probability mechanism.
training_view_filter: joins actual goalie log; does not filter start_flag
